BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers - We Get The Pick Of The Crop

TAKE AN EXCLUSIVE HUME VIRTUAL TOUR NOW. CLICK BELOW

This exceptionally bright dual aspect ground floor apartment enjoys a most convenient location at the entrance to Kilminchy Village on the Dublin Road. The property is within walking distance of Portlaoise Hospital, shops, and schools.

The property is superbly spacious, and being ground floor offers exceptionable accessibility. 

With ample parking to the front and beautiful green space to the rear, this large apartment feels unlike any other, with a huge emphasis on space and light.

The large open plan space is truly massive with three distinct spaces for cooking, dining, and seating.
With large picture windows, this space enjoys excellent light and views.
The two bedrooms are large doubles, and the master bedroom enjoys a full ensuite.

The bathroom is fully tiled and completes the accommodation.

Kilminchy Village is a most sought-after neighbourhood. Designed by internationally renowned architect Melville Dunbar. Killinchy?s design is based upon the highly regarded Essex town plan, which has been executed to a magnificent standard in this most convenient location and resembles the meandering streets of a small village or town.

Within the development is a neighbourhood centre to include, shops, restaurants, Pharmacy, and a gastropub. The recreational amenities are excellent too and include natural lakes, a purpose-built basketball court and acres of green space.


Schools, shops, leisure centre and the hospital are all within walking distance, whilst Portlaoise town centre and the M7 motorway are just a few minutes away by car.

There is a magnificent hourly Bus service to Dublin which stops at the entrance, every hour day and night.

The development has been prewired with fibre optic broadband cable and speeds of up to 1gb are available.
New Portlaoise Bus Route Stops At Entrance With Round The Clock Access To Train, Schools & Town Centre
